caption:
Your first anime decides whether there is a second one. Three doors, three starters: Jujutsu Kaisen for action, Delicious in Dungeon for fantasy, Skip and Loafer for slice of life.

Every one works with zero anime homework.

Send this to the friend who says anime is not for them. Then ask which door they picked.
